reviewer: Claude Opus 5 independent final post-fix review via Claude Pro

findings.issue: "se mantienen legalmente a través de la Auroville Foundation" is a calque of English "held through"; Spanish "mantener" does not carry the sense of holding legal title, so the ownership statement reads as "are kept via" rather than "are legally held by".
findings.recommended_text: Una ciudad internacional en Tamil Nadu que desde 1968 experimenta con vida comunal, práctica ecológica y organización social alternativa; la tierra y los activos están legalmente en manos de la Auroville Foundation en lugar de ser propiedad individual de los residentes.

findings.issue: "las residentes son dueñas" introduces a feminine-only reference that is absent from the gender-neutral English "residents own their homes" and is inconsistent with the generic masculine used throughout the rest of the Spanish overlay.
findings.recommended_text: Un fideicomiso comunitario de tierras gestionado por ocho comunidades en San Juan que mantiene colectivamente tierras públicas mientras los residentes son dueños de sus viviendas y reciben protección a largo plazo frente al desplazamiento.

findings.issue: "siete hogares" renders "seven homes" as households rather than dwelling units; in a housing-project description the correct term is "viviendas".
findings.recommended_text: Un proyecto habitacional de Community Land Trust Brussels con siete viviendas, una sala compartida y un jardín semipúblico en Anderlecht.

findings.issue: "ecologización" denotes making policy or practice more ecological, not the physical greening of a neighbourhood that the English "greening" means alongside housing and community spaces.
findings.recommended_text: Un fideicomiso de tierras comunitarias liderado por residentes en Liverpool que asegura vivienda permanentemente asequible, espacios comunitarios, creación de zonas verdes y actividad económica local en el barrio.

findings.issue: "minihidráulica" designates mini-hydro (roughly 1–10 MW), a different scale class from the source's "micro-hydropower"; French and Portuguese correctly use micro-scale terms.
findings.recommended_text: Un sistema microhidroeléctrico gestionado por la comunidad en Kampung Buayan, Sabah, cuyo comité local organiza las tarifas de consumo, la remuneración de operadores, las piezas de repuesto y las reparaciones futuras.

findings.issue: "1,006 hectáreas" uses the comma as a thousands separator; in Spain and most of South America the comma is the decimal mark, so the figure can be read as 1.006 hectares. RAE writes four-digit numbers without a separator.
findings.recommended_text: La Pachgaon Gram Sabha gestiona 1006 hectáreas de bosque mediante derechos reconocidos de Community Forest Resource, combinando decisiones democráticas con la protección forestal y la cosecha y venta de bambú para medios de vida locales.

findings.issue: "17,000 socios" uses comma digit grouping, which conflicts with the decimal comma used across most of the Spanish-speaking world; RAE recommends a space for grouping in neutral Spanish.
findings.recommended_text: Una tienda de comestibles de propiedad de sus socios en Brooklyn cuyos aproximadamente 17 000 socios sostienen las compras, las operaciones y las normas mediante turnos de trabajo, participaciones de capital y procedimientos democráticos.

findings.issue: Gender agreement error: the implicit subject of "reparar" is "las personas" (feminine), so the predicative adjective must be "juntas", not "juntos".
findings.recommended_text: Una red mundial de encuentros de reparación voluntarios y no comerciales donde las personas comparten herramientas, conocimientos y tiempo para reparar juntas objetos cotidianos y desarrollar habilidades locales de reparación.

findings.issue: Singular "global" after two coordinated nouns attaches only to "plataforma", losing the source's scope in which "Global" qualifies both network and platform; the French and Arabic overlays render the scope correctly.
findings.recommended_text: Red y plataforma globales para la reparación comunitaria

findings.issue: "protection à long terme contre les expulsions" narrows the source's "protection from displacement" to eviction specifically, dropping the broader displacement/gentrification sense that the CLT model addresses.
findings.recommended_text: Une fiducie foncière communautaire gérée par huit communautés à San Juan qui détient collectivement des terrains publics, tandis que les habitants sont propriétaires de leurs logements et bénéficient d’une protection à long terme contre le déplacement.

findings.issue: "New York City" is untranslated English in a French geographic label; standard French usage is "New York" (or "ville de New York"). The Spanish, Portuguese and Arabic overlays all localise this toponym.
findings.recommended_text: New York

findings.issue: "des informations tenues par les communautés" reads as information held by the communities rather than maintained/kept up to date by them; the Spanish and Portuguese overlays use "mantenida/mantidas".
findings.recommended_text: Base de données publique Citizens’ Forest contenant des informations maintenues par les communautés sur les forêts communautaires de Thaïlande

findings.issue: The qualifier "local" from the English "local use sites" is dropped; the Spanish, French and Arabic overlays all retain it.
findings.recommended_text: Aldeias, estruturas hídricas e pontos de uso local na bacia

findings.issue: "cuja governança consta como das comunidades locais" is a syntactically strained rendering of "whose governance is recorded as local communities"; the elliptical "consta como das" is hard to parse.
findings.recommended_text: Uma área protegida publicamente registrada em Belize, cuja governança está registrada como sendo das comunidades locais e cuja responsabilidade de gestão é exercida por comitês locais.

findings.issue: "fideicomisso fundiário comunitário" imports a Spanish-flavoured calque; in Brazilian Portuguese "fideicomisso" is a distinct inheritance-law institute, and the established term for a community land trust is "termo territorial coletivo".
findings.recommended_text: Um termo territorial coletivo (community land trust) liderado por moradores em Liverpool que assegura moradia permanentemente acessível, espaços comunitários, áreas verdes e atividade econômica local no bairro.

findings.issue: Orthography: under the Acordo Ortográfico the prefix "co-" is written solid before a consonant, so "co-desenhados" should be "codesenhados".
findings.recommended_text: Uma rede crescente de espaços públicos codesenhados e operados com grupos de moradores em Kibera, articulando resiliência a inundações, serviços básicos, locais de encontro e uso econômico local.

findings.issue: "proprietários costumeiros" means habitual/usual owners; the legal term for "customary owners" in Portuguese is "consuetudinários", as used correctly in the Spanish overlay.
findings.recommended_text: Uma reserva marinha administrada pelos proprietários consuetudinários de recursos do Distrito de Kubulau, em Fiji, onde regras comunitárias, fiscalização e financiamento protegem a pesca e os meios de vida locais.

findings.issue: Mis-parse of the English "Public education, organizational and participation information": "Educação pública" is read as a separate item instead of "public" qualifying all three kinds of information. Spanish, French and Arabic parse it correctly.
findings.recommended_text: Informações públicas educacionais, organizacionais e de participação

findings.issue: "acesso à internet acessível" both echoes "acesso" and is ambiguous, since "acessível" reads first as "accessible" rather than the intended "affordable".
findings.recommended_text: Uma rede comunitária administrada por voluntários na cidade de Nova York que conecta acesso à internet a preço acessível, autodeterminação digital e infraestrutura local construída em conjunto.

findings.issue: Gender agreement error: the implicit subject of "consertar" is "as pessoas" (feminine), so the predicative must be "juntas"; the placement after the object also obscures the reference.
findings.recommended_text: Uma rede mundial de encontros de reparo voluntários e não comerciais, onde as pessoas compartilham ferramentas, conhecimento e tempo para consertar juntas objetos do dia a dia e desenvolver habilidades locais de reparo.

findings.issue: Orthography: "auto-" before a consonant-initial element is written solid with r-doubling, so "auto-replicantes" should be "autorreplicantes".
findings.recommended_text: Documentação de design aberto e um wiki comunitário para máquinas de fabricação autorreplicantes

findings.issue: Singular "global" after two coordinated nouns attaches only to "plataforma", so "Global network" loses its qualifier; the French and Arabic overlays render the scope correctly.
findings.recommended_text: Rede e plataforma globais para reparo comunitário

findings.issue: Transliteration error: "Caño" is rendered "كاينو" (kaynu) instead of "كانيو"; the same overlay transliterates "Peña" correctly as "بينيا", so the ñ handling is internally inconsistent.
findings.recommended_text: ثمانية مجتمعات على امتداد كانيو مارتين بينيا، سان خوان، بورتوريكو

findings.issue: Grammar: "أراضيًا" is incorrect. أراضٍ is a منقوص diptote (ممنوع من الصرف), whose indefinite accusative is أراضِيَ without tanwin.
findings.recommended_text: شبكة لاقتصاد التضامن في جاكسون بولاية مسيسيبي تطوّر معًا تعاونيات عمالية ومؤسسات ذات إدارة ذاتية ديمقراطية وأراضيَ تحتفظ بها المجتمعات وإسكانًا ميسور التكلفة وبنية تحتية للإنتاج المحلي.

findings.issue: Tanwin-alif orthography is inconsistent inside a single string: "تخضيرًا" uses the ـًا form while "إسكاناً", "نشاطاً", "اقتصادياً" and "محلياً" use ـاً in the same coordinated list.
findings.recommended_text: صندوق أراضٍ مجتمعي يقوده السكان في ليفربول يؤمّن إسكانًا ميسور التكلفة بشكل دائم ومساحات مجتمعية وتخضيرًا ونشاطًا اقتصاديًا محليًا في الحي.

findings.issue: "منتخبين من جمعية السكان" reads as "elected from (among) the Residents’ Association" rather than the source's "elected by the Residents’ Association"; the agentive requires من قِبَل.
findings.recommended_text: تملك Isle of Eigg Heritage Trust الجزيرة وتديرها لصالح سكانها؛ ويشكّل أربعة مديرين منتخبين من قِبَل جمعية السكان قرارات تتعلق بالأرض والإسكان والبنية التحتية والتراث الطبيعي وشبكة الكهرباء المحلية.

findings.issue: "تحمي APCRM والسكان من ثماني قرى ... المخزون السمكي" invites the wrong reading "protects the residents from eight villages", because تحمي … من is the standard protect-from frame; the intended sense is "residents of eight villages".
findings.recommended_text: تحمي APCRM وسكان ثماني قرى في وسط كازامانس المخزونَ السمكي المحلي عبر مناطق استخدام مرمّزة بالألوان، وقيود على الصيد، والمراقبة والدوريات، ضمن حقوق الإدارة الساحلية المفوّضة في عام 2010.

findings.issue: Word order: "يدعم نحو 17,000 عضو فيها المشتريات" strands فيها between subject and object; the adverbial should follow the verb for a well-formed MSA relative clause.
findings.recommended_text: منشأة بقالة مملوكة للأعضاء في بروكلين يدعم فيها نحو 17,000 عضو المشترياتِ والعملياتِ والقواعدَ من خلال نوبات العمل وحصص رأس المال والإجراءات الديمقراطية.

findings.issue: Terminology inconsistency: mangrove is transliterated "المنغروف" here but "مانغروف" in mikoko-pamoja within the same overlay.
findings.recommended_text: منطقة بحرية تُدار بالاشتراك من قبل المجتمعات الساحلية حول أندافادواكا، وتربط الصيد المستدام والرصد والمناطق المحمية والشعاب المرجانية وأشجار المانغروف.

findings.issue: "حكومات محلية مستقلة" says "independent local governments", shifting the source's "local autonomous governments"; Arabic marks autonomy with ذاتي, and the overlay itself uses إدارة ذاتية for the comparable North and East Syria entry.
findings.recommended_text: هيكل حكم ذاتي تحافظ عليه مجتمعات زاباتيستا في تشياباس، وقد حل منذ عام 2023 محل MAREZ ومجالس الحكم الرشيد السابقة بحكومات محلية ذاتية الحكم وجماعات إقليمية وتنسيق قائم على الجمعيات.

findings.issue: Apostrophe typography is mixed across the French overlay: most entries use the typographic apostrophe (U+2019) while roughly thirty, including this one, use the straight ASCII apostrophe (U+0027). Style only; no meaning affected.
findings.recommended_text: Une plateforme communautaire et open source australienne à but non lucratif qui permet aux producteurs et aux initiatives alimentaires d’organiser des circuits d’approvisionnement courts, transparents et contrôlés par la communauté.

findings.issue: About ten French summaries open telegraphically without a determiner (enspiral, ethiopia-community-seed-bank-network, fecofun-nepal, fordhall-organic-farm, freifunk, freifunk-hamburg, g0v, great-lakes-commons, ekuri-community-forest, tla-o-qui-aht-tribal-parks) while the remaining entries open with "Un/Une". Register inconsistency only.
findings.recommended_text: Un réseau collaboratif né en Aotearoa Nouvelle-Zélande qui développe des formes d’entreprise orientées vers la communauté, des ressources partagées et des outils documentés en libre accès pour la collaboration décentralisée.

findings.issue: Four stacked modifiers leave "australiana" stranded after "sem fins lucrativos", making the opening noun phrase hard to parse. Grammatical; readability only.
findings.recommended_text: Uma plataforma australiana comunitária, sem fins lucrativos e de código aberto que permite a produtores e iniciativas alimentares organizar cadeias de abastecimento curtas, transparentes e controladas pela comunidade.

findings.issue: The proclitic conjunction و is written detached with a space before the Latin-script run ("و E-Networking"); the same pattern occurs in open-food-facts ("و API") and root-access-hackerspace ("و Discord"). Mixed-script typography only; rendering and direction are correct.
findings.recommended_text: تدير المجتمعات المحلية وE-Networking Research and Development شبكة اتصالات ريفية في نيبال، تربط البنية التحتية اللاسلكية والتعليم والخدمات المحلية.

review_notes: All four target overlays matched the required SHA-256 digests byte for byte; en.json digest is 97d084727349070505fc19a3fb2463c1aa3241f227821270e7e60a2a6c32bb97.

Each target locale contains exactly the same 88 project ids as en.json, with identical geographic_label id sets and identical digital_label presence per project; no titles appear in any target overlay, as expected.
Every summary, every geographic_labels value and every digital_label in all four locales was read and compared against en.json.

All quantities, dates and named entities were cross-checked (more than 50 organizations, 17,000 members, 1,006 hectares, eight communities, five aflaj areas, four directors, seven homes, 1968, 2010, 2018, 2023); no factual omission, invention or numeric drift was found in any locale.
No blocker- or major-severity defect survived verification; the previously reported major and the 47 minors show no re-occurrence in the current files.

Untranslated English is confined to organization and project names (Community Land Trust Brussels, Isle of Eigg Heritage Trust, Auroville Foundation, Terra Concordia gGmbH, E-Networking Research and Development, Tetepare Descendants’ Association, Factor e Farm, Meadowbank/Portobello Tool Library, Granby Four Streets, Repair Café, Citizens’ Forest Database, Pachgaon Gram Sabha, Internet Archive) and accepted acronyms (ODbL, API, NACSO, WCS, FAO, LoRa/LoRaWAN, TONIBUNG, MAREZ, ICT/TIC, Discord).
Arabic numeral-noun gender polarity was checked for every counted noun (ثمانية مجتمعات, ثماني قرى, سبعة منازل, خمسة مجتمعات, خمس مناطق, أربعة مديرين) and is correct throughout.

Arabic mixed-script runs render correctly for direction; embedded Latin organization names, the Anderlecht street address and the Le Nid building label carry no bidi hazards beyond the detached-و typography noted above.
Arabic tanwin-alif spelling alternates between the ـًا and ـاً forms across the file; both are accepted, and only the case where both appear inside one string is reported as a finding.

Spanish digit grouping with commas (1,006 and 17,000) is reported because the comma is the decimal mark in Spain and most of South America, which conflicts with the neutral-Spanish target; French (1 006 / 17 000), Portuguese (1.006 / 17.000) and Arabic conventions are correct.
Terminology is otherwise consistent within each locale, including the recurring anchor vocabulary (ancla/ancrage/âncora/مرجع) and the commons vocabulary (bienes comunes/communs/bens comuns/المشاعات).
No web sources were consulted; the review is a closed comparison of the five files at the stated digests.
